posts.text: Why the Markets Don’t Care About the Midterms — Factors like inflation, interest rates, A.I. and the war with Iran are far more important, our columnist says.

Congress 'needs to have a spine and stand up to this insanity': Independent candidate on Iran war — A new poll finds only 24% of adults approve of President Trump's war with Iran. Independent candidate in Nebraska's Senate race Dan Osborn joins Peter Alexander to share how he would find a way to end the conflict if elected.
‘Need a Plan B’: Yemenis in Aden prepare for another war as missiles fall — As Houthi missiles strike Aden, residents stockpile food and prepare escape plans, fearing a return to all-out war.

The First State to Undo Legalized Weed? Plus. . . — In today’s Front Page, Josh Code reports on the Massachusetts vote that could make it the first state to undo legal weed. Is Ohio turning blue? Aaron MacLean on Trump’s options in Iran. A doctor’s guide to microplastics. And more.

If Trump Gets Another Supreme Court Pick, MAGA Wants a Loyalist — For years, Supreme Court aspirants have avoided talking about how they might rule. Trump’s frustrations with his first-term picks could change that.
Senators briefed on Trump’s ‘insane’ plan to restart war on Iran — Senator Chris Murphy says he’s been briefed on Trump’s plan to restart the war on Iran.

How Trump Can Fight Iran After the Midterms — Win or lose, once the midterm elections are over, the president will have more options than he does right now, though none of them is a sure path to victory, writes Aaron MacLean.

Americans 'frustrated' about Iran war going into midterms as Trump admin has decision to make: GOP lawmaker — House Armed Services Committee member Pat Harrigan says the U.S., in the ongoing conflict against Iran, must "do what it takes to either win or come home."
Senators briefed on Trump’s ‘insane’ plan to restart war on Iran — Senator Chris Murphy warns Trump’s reported plan to restart war with Iran could have devastating consequences.

U.S. Oil Industry Earned Over $130 Billion in Profit During Iran War — That was almost three times as much as what businesses producing and refining oil in the United States made in the same period in 2025.

Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general — Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.

Bibi FREAKS: Says ARABS RIGGED ELECTION As He Plans IRAN STRIKE — Krystal and Saagar discuss Bibi losing it claiming Arabs rigged the Israeli elections. Albanian opposition lawmakers disrupt parliament with smoke flares and furious attacks on socialist PM — Sali Berisha's microphone was cut after he declared ruling lawmakers "deserve tear gas" as Democratic Party members lit flares inside parliament.

Libertarians challenge Trump-backed Republicans, look to shake up midterms beyond GOP-Dem duopoly — Libertarian candidate Jeremy Todd is running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Kentucky's 4th Congressional District after incumbent Rep. Thomas Massie lost the GOP primary.

Houthis hold 37 UN food workers as Trump-backed WFP chief inherits humanitarian crises across globe — Luke Lindberg says 37 World Food Programme employees are detained by Houthis in Yemen, with some separated from families for nearly two years.

DoorDash strikes $17B deal for rival Instacart in bet on grocery delivery — DoorDash is buying grocery delivery platform Instacart as it looks to expand beyond restaurant delivery and strengthen its position in the U.S. grocery market.
